About

Across engineering, astrophysics, and AI.

I am a machine-learning researcher with a PhD in astrophysics and a foundation in mechanical engineering. I work at the point where physical models, statistical inference, and large scientific datasets meet.

Experience

From lensing inference to time-domain astronomy.

2025—Now

Postdoctoral Researcher

University of Rome Tor Vergata

Developing machine-learning algorithms for the detection and classification of transient astronomical sources in Rubin LSST data, with collaborative work in high-energy transient science.

2020—2025

PhD Researcher

IUCAA, Pune

Designed CNN and Bayesian neural-network systems for strong-lens parameter inference, built simulated datasets, validated models on real observations, and investigated simulation-to-real differences.
